steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The Lord's Prayer (Matthew 6:9-13) is the most important Christian prayer. Jesus taught it to his disciples when they asked him how to pray. It includes praise ("Our Father in heaven, hallowed be your name"), petition ("Give us today our daily bread") and confession ("Forgive us our debts"). | RS Exam Tips — Prayer: 1. For Prayer questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3. Use specialist vocabulary precisely (e.g. terms from the specification) 4. Evaluate by analysing strengths and weaknesses of different views before reaching your conclusion 5. Link your discussion of Prayer to its real-world impact on believers and society

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Explain two types of Christian prayer with examples. | "Prayer does not work." Evaluate this statement.

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on RS Exam Tips — Prayer, and one past-paper question.
